notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth of the Healing House and Llanowar Loamspeaker do not have summoning sickness.
Arixmethes is a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Llanowar Loamspeaker's second ability by tapping it, causing Minamo to become a 3/3 Elemental creature with haste that's still a land until end of turn.
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House's second ability by tapping it, untapping Minamo and Arixmethes.
Repeat from step 2.
